name: Heatwave
paragraphs: Heatwave is a realistic rippling heat distortion effect with controls for intensity, direction, speed, amount, and more.
Five fiery presets come ready to help you simulate a variety of simmering looks. Find these via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Heatwave look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
